items.stem: Which of the following statements about diseases is correct?

options.text: Having a risk factor does not mean a person will definitely get the disease.
All non-infectious diseases are caused by pathogens.
Infectious diseases cannot be prevented by vaccination.

Virus: cannot multiply in human cells · Bacteria: cannot multiply in human cells

items.stem: Cervical cancer is classified as a non-infectious disease, but HPV infection is a major risk factor. Which explanation is the most accurate?

options.text: Cervical cancer itself is spread by droplets, so it is infectious.
HPV is not a pathogen, so the cancer cannot be linked to infection.
The cancer is not transmitted from person to person, even though an infectious virus can increase the risk of developing it.
All cancers are infectious because some are linked to viruses.
